page.content:
Blatty's 1971 bestseller.

How The Exorcist (novel) connects

  • Creator: William Peter Blatty — Blatty wrote the 1971 novel.
  • Topic: The Exorcist — The novel is the source of The Exorcist.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — Blatty's novel was adapted into the 1973 film.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — The 1973 film is adapted from Blatty's novel.

What is The Exorcist (novel)?

The Exorcist novel follows Chris MacNeil in Georgetown as Regan's condition worsens and Fathers Karras and Merrin are drawn into an exorcism.

Key threads lead to William Peter Blatty, The Exorcist, The Exorcist (1973) and The Exorcist (1973).
